issues.reason:
*Propositional attitudes* names say among the verbs it covers and states that the construction "reifies the attitude as an event with Experiencer = the holder", and the QA template rebuilds (Member $e ) (Experiencer $e ) (Theme $e

), so statement/question parity requires Experiencer here even though the general progressive test would give an eventive speech verb an Agent.

The half that stands: free-choice "anything" is universal and the witness does not record that force — a real coverage gap the reviewer also files; the half that does not: an existential is entailed by the universal and lives entirely inside a seal, so it puts nothing false or over-asserted into the KB (the defect criterion is over-assertion, not under-assertion), and the licensed universal form is an Implication that nothing licenses sealing.

(Member sk_thing_1 less) is ill-typed twice over: adjectives lemmatize to the base form (never the comparative), and *Comparatives* licenses a comparative only as the ordering (More <scale> X Y), so the conjunct is removed — with no standard available for the elided "less than that", no More atom can replace it.

gaps_confirmed: direct quotation as a speech complement — the attitude rule is stated for a finite "that"-clause, and nothing covers quoted speech or preserving the surface string
free-choice "anything / anyone / anything less" quantification, and in particular no licensed way to seal a universal (sealing takes an atom or an (And ...), not an Implication)
a comparative with an elided standard ("anything less" = less than that) — nothing supplies More's second argument
new_gaps: the role of a speech-attitude holder is doubly specified: *Propositional attitudes* assigns Experiencer to its listed verbs (say, claim), while the thematic-role progressive test would make an eventive speech verb's subject an Agent — the sections do not say which governs
repair_summary: Changed the say event's holder from Agent to Experiencer per the attitude section (proof name aligned to say_exp); dropped the ill-typed (Member sk_thing_1 less) conjunct from the sealed quote, leaving the weaker but true and entailed sealed record.
notes: The sealed term is kept rather than deleted because after removing the comparative conjunct nothing in it is false, ill-typed or over-asserted — an existential is strictly weaker than the free-choice universal Gordon uttered. The appositive's past wrapper on both Member and PartOf, and "House Space and Aeronautics" keeping lowercase subcommittee outside the name, are correct and untouched.
